overlaps.package_item: Required metric panel (6-column metric definitions, OWN/PEER target methods, red flags, improvement paths)
overlaps.existing_mechanism: GO-SCIENCE GATE (ROI the key metric) + STATUS.yaml fleet pulse
overlaps.note: Adopt the metric-definition structure and OWN/PEER benchmark classes; go-science ROI doctrine remains the governing key metric — panel metrics slot under it, not above it.

overlaps.package_item: Monitoring cadence Phase 7 (daily/weekly 8-12wk/monthly/quarterly + alerts) and 24h/72h/7d/28d stabilisation comparisons
overlaps.existing_mechanism: Monday lints, STATUS.yaml session-end pulse, R6 continuous monitoring (owner building the monitoring tool; we produce before/after inputs)
overlaps.note: Adopt cadence definitions as the spec the owner's monitoring tool consumes; agent produces the before/after inputs per R6 rather than owning dashboards.

overlaps.package_item: Phase 8 continuous improvement loop (hypothesis, guardrails, one controlled change, adopt/iterate/revert/retire, experiment learning register)
overlaps.existing_mechanism: No v1 equivalent (designs frozen; no post-launch experiment loop)
overlaps.note: New capability for the post-launch era; experiment changes to shipped sites must still route through PR + owner merge approval (agent never self-merges).

overlaps.package_item: Competitor and market-share requirements (9 sets, 7 opportunity classes, monthly panel/quarterly map, archived SERP/ad evidence)
overlaps.existing_mechanism: Competitor-map inside v1 fat strategy approval; R4 ask-don't-assume for competitor inputs
overlaps.note: Much richer than v1 competitor-map; competitor roster must be ASKED/confirmed by owner per R4 (Gate 0 'competitor roster' aligns); 'do not infer spend from ad library' matches never-invent doctrine.

overlaps.package_item: Workflow selection rule (6 variants; primary + declared overlays; no silent scope merge)
overlaps.existing_mechanism: v1 single launch flow + 3 site classes (commerce/organic/landing) in gates/registry.yaml
overlaps.note: Package axis (business model x new/existing x website/organic/landing) must be reconciled with the registry's 3 classes so gate applicability (required|adapted|n_a) keys off one classification, not two.

overlaps.package_item: B2B trust controls (proof with permission, real case studies, legal entity, contact ownership)
overlaps.existing_mechanism: HARD GATE never invent facts/IDs/prices; clinical sign-off for medical claims
overlaps.note: Consistent; for KTAHV B2B surfaces (doctor referral, corporate wellness) the clinical language lock and Dr. Deepu sign-off must be layered on — package is silent on clinical content.

overlaps.package_item: Interview operators/sales/support; confirm access and identify missing data BEFORE recommendations (Phase 0/1)
overlaps.existing_mechanism: R4 ASK-WHEN-IN-DOUBT; unattended rule (blocked -> QUESTIONS.md)
overlaps.note: Direct implementation of R4; wire the asks through QUESTIONS.md/owner sessions.

overlaps.package_item: Issue register with issue IDs, priority, owner, dependencies, acceptance criteria; every change mapped to a requirement/issue ID
overlaps.existing_mechanism: GitHub issues/PRs as truth (boot contract: GitHub over markdown logs)
overlaps.note: Use GitHub issues as the issue register backend; adopt the required fields as the issue template.

overlaps.package_item: Overlay statement 'The original checklist remains valid; this overlay adds controls'
overlaps.existing_mechanism: v1 rule: gates are added, never weakened
overlaps.note: Package's own additive posture matches v1 doctrine; cite it in the merge plan as the governing merge rule.

overlaps.package_item: Landing-page experiment framework (control/variant, sample size, guardrails before traffic, previous control preserved)
overlaps.existing_mechanism: No v1 equivalent; v1 golden-page doctrine governs page quality, not experiments
overlaps.note: New; low-traffic Kairali pages may make formal sample-size testing n_a — needs an applicability rule per site class.

overlaps.package_item: 12-month technical/content/authority roadmap (organic P2)
overlaps.existing_mechanism: 30-day rebuild sprint horizon; polish time-box
overlaps.note: Different planning horizons coexist: sprint = build, roadmap = post-launch organic programme; owner to confirm the roadmap obligation per site.

new_capabilities: Six-variant workflow selection matrix (new/existing x website/organic/landing) with primary-workflow + declared-overlay rule and 'do not silently merge scopes'
Phase 0-8 gated skeleton with named per-gate evidence bundles and per-phase do-not-proceed conditions (phase control and proof matrix)
12-field exact finding format including what-must-not-be-done and excluded-alternatives fields (R2/R3 enabler)
OWN vs PEER benchmark classes with peer median / upper-quartile / leader percentile ladder under identical market/device/language/period

9-type competitor set taxonomy (incl. AI-answer and aspirational) + 7-class opportunity classification (defend/mandatory parity/flank/attack/category-creation/partner/deliberate-ignore) + monthly panel / quarterly map cadence
Decision/Exclusion Register with 6-state decision classification (included/deferred/not applicable/rejected/unknown/accepted-risk)
SHA-256 evidence manifests with never-overwrite-baseline rule and closed-issue linkage chain (implementation ref -> staging proof -> live proof -> monitored result)

Structured metric dictionary rows (ID/Metric/Source/Target method/Red flag/Improvement path) incl. CRM-layer B2B metrics: MQL-to-SQL (B2B-001), pipeline sourced/influenced (B2B-002), lead response SLA (B2B-003)
AI-visibility metric AI-002 prompt mention share via controlled prompt panel with confidence intervals
6-way URL disposition chain protect/refresh/consolidate/redirect/archive-noindex/retire (richer than v1 KEEP/MERGE/301)
Preservation register + change-impact register + rule against simultaneous URL/intent/content/layout/offer/tracking changes
Launch Readiness certificate + launch command centre with recorded release time/version/participants and rollback rehearsal
Post-launch stabilisation discipline: 24h full crawl compare, 24h/72h/7d/28d windows, 4-8 week operating baseline before normalising targets, 8-12 week weekly monitoring
Phase 8 continuous improvement loop with hypothesis/guardrail/rollback template and adopt-iterate-revert-retire outcomes + experiment learning register

Message-match chain spec (ad/query/referrer -> headline/proof/offer/CTA) + traffic-source/message-match matrix + page indexability classification (indexable/paid-only-noindex/evergreen/temporary/test-variant)
B2B-specific control lists: 5 trust controls, 5 content controls, 5 competitive-edge controls, 3 market-share attack patterns, mandatory B2B report pack
5-way finding label taxonomy (observed fact / calculated result / tool estimate / user-provided assumption / recommendation)
Escalation rule: commercial truth outranks third-party SEO scores — never optimise for the score
conflicts: Phase 5 execution steps (deploy to production, DNS/SSL/CDN plan, robots validation as part of release, Search Console sitemap submission) assume the workflow operator performs them; v1 HARD GATES forbid agent DNS/robots changes and production writes, and production DNS flips are always human — executor must be split agent-validates / owner-executes, else HARD GATES 1 and 3 are violated.

Gate 5 'completed real conversion' and landing-workflow 'run real submissions/purchases' write real lead/order records into production CRM/payment systems — collides with the no-production-writes doctrine unless the owner defines a marked test-conversion protocol and performs/authorizes it himself (payments could never be agent-executed).

AI-agent execution rule 9 instructs the agent to write new learnings directly into shared standards and workflow files; v1 doctrine requires owner rulings (DECISIONS.md) for doctrine/gate changes and owner-approved merges — must be narrowed to 'propose via PR/DIRECTIVES.md, owner approves'.

The 9-role sign-off table, if adopted literally, distributes gate-approval authority across roles that do not exist in this one-owner shop; any mapping that lets a non-owner (or the agent wearing a role hat) sign a gate would weaken the owner-only approval rule and HARD GATE 9 (agent never self-merges/self-approves).

The package skeleton contains NO design_source/golden_page front gates, no external dual-AI design review, no beauty gate, no go-science gate, and no clinical sign-off step — adopting it as the replacement workflow without explicitly re-homing these would silently weaken v1 gates and breach R8 (this is the central merge risk of the file).

Internal package inconsistency: the base checklist puts build at Phase 3 and launch at Phase 5, while the overlay proof matrix describes implementation at row 4 and release at row 6 — must be normalized to one numbering in the merged OS or gate evidence will misalign.

Overlay P0 requires defining 'prohibited actions' per project — fine, but the package nowhere states that its prohibitions are a floor; the merge must state v1 HARD GATES 1-9 override and cannot be redefined per-project.
injection_flags: Each of the six workflows contains an 'AI-agent execution rules' section (9 numbered imperatives addressed directly to an AI agent, repeated 6x — e.g. lines 284-294, 664-674, 1040-1050, 1428-1438, 1803-1813, 2190-2200). Content is benign procedural governance, no URLs, no commands, no exfiltration — but it is instruction-to-agent text inside data and must only bind after owner adoption, not because the file says so.

Rule 9 ('Add new learnings to the shared standard and relevant workflow') is a standing self-modification instruction to the agent — flagged both as injection-style (data instructing the agent to alter its own governing documents) and as a conflict with owner-ruling doctrine.

'Run and archive the exact ... reports specified in TOOL_STACK_REGISTER.csv' (repeated 6x) directs the agent to execute whatever an external CSV specifies; that CSV must be reviewed by a human before any run list derived from it is executed — do not execute tool runs blindly from a package-supplied register.

No URLs, shell commands, credentials requests, or hidden/encoded text found anywhere in the file; no impersonation of system/owner authority; overall injection risk low but the three items above require explicit owner adoption gating.
open_questions: Entity mapping: which Kairali properties run under the B2B manual (KAPPL bulk/distributor and export enquiries? Kairali Group corporate? KTAHV doctor-referral/corporate-wellness pages?) and does a mixed site declare B2B as primary workflow or overlay?

Classification reconciliation: should gates/registry.yaml's three site classes (commerce/organic/landing) be extended to key off the package's business-model x new/existing x asset-type matrix, or should the package workflows be tagged with the existing three classes?

Role map: who fills each of the 9 sign-off roles in reality — is owner = both 'Accountable business owner' and 'Project/product owner', and does ChatGPT+Perplexity dual audit count as the 'QA independent test execution' role, with launch-gate human review always = Abilash?

Real-conversion test protocol: how are Gate 5 live test leads/purchases performed and marked (test-lead flag in CRM, who submits, refund/void procedure for payment paths) without violating no-production-writes?
Which CRM is the system of record for the CRM-sourced metric panel (COM-004/005, B2B-001/002/003)? No CRM is declared in the v1 OS; several sites route enquiries to the director@ mailbox.

Tool procurement: adopt which of the new mandatory tools (Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs/equivalent, STAT/AccuRanker, Hotjar, ABM platforms, company enrichment, webinar tools, sales engagement/call intelligence) versus mark adapted/n_a per site class — licence cost is an owner decision (R7 map should record the ruling per step).
Horizon: is the organic workflows' 12-month technical/content/authority roadmap mandatory per site now, or deferred until after the 30-day rebuild sprint completes?

Experiment applicability: for low-traffic Kairali pages, when is the landing control/variant + sample-size requirement n_a, and what evidence substitutes (per package's own realistic-benchmark doctrine)?

Monitoring ownership: Phase 7 weekly-for-8-12-weeks and monthly/quarterly cadences — executed by the agent producing R6 before/after inputs, or absorbed by the owner's separate monitoring tool once built?
Numbering ruling: adopt base-checklist numbering (build=3, launch=5) or overlay numbering (implement=4, release=6) as canonical for the merged OS?

Duplication cleanup: may the merge dedupe the verbatim-repeated Phase 1 trust/content control items and collapse the six near-identical workflow bodies into one B2B skeleton + delta tables, or must package files be preserved verbatim as received (SHA-verified) with the merged OS layered separately?

registers.name: Issue register
registers.columns: issue ID, phase, severity (P0/P1...), priority, owner, dependencies, acceptance criteria, evidence + affected URLs, retest evidence
registers.purpose: Backlog and defect tracking; every change maps to a requirement or issue ID; no closure without retest evidence (Gate 2 deliverable + AI rules 4-5).

registers.name: Decision/Exclusion Register
registers.columns: decision state (included | deferred | not applicable | rejected | unknown | accepted-risk), reason
registers.purpose: Records why recommendations were ignored/excluded; do-not-do register item 6 mandates its use; overlay P8 tracks its changes.

registers.name: Preservation register (+ change-impact register)
registers.columns: URL/asset, classification (protect/refresh/consolidate/redirect/archive-noindex/retire), captured evidence (screenshots, copy, metadata, schema, internal links, conversion components), change impact
registers.purpose: EXISTING-variant deliverable protecting ranked/converting/linked/offline-referenced assets; deletion/redirect prohibited without it.

registers.name: Master URL inventory
registers.columns: URL, discovery sources, commercial value signals (rankings, conversions, backlinks, paid, referral, offline references)
registers.purpose: Built from every discovery source, never navigation/sitemap alone; prerequisite for any URL disposition.

registers.name: Redirect/change map
registers.columns: old URL -> new URL, control metrics, rollback triggers
registers.purpose: EXISTING-variant launch deliverable; release proceeds only with map + rollback triggers active.

registers.name: Access register / access-risk register
registers.columns: first-party system, access status, missing data
registers.purpose: Gate 0 evidence; confirms access before recommendations (R4-aligned).

registers.name: Competitor evidence matrix / competitor roster
registers.columns: competitor set type (direct/SERP/paid/marketplace/local/publisher/substitute/AI-answer/aspirational), archived pages/ads/offers/reviews/SERPs with date+region+source, peer median/upper-quartile/leader values
registers.purpose: Gate 0 roster + Phase 1 evidence; monthly priority panel, quarterly full map.

registers.name: Control/variant and experiment register (+ experiment learning register)
registers.columns: hypothesis, control/variant, sample-size approach, primary metric, guardrails, owner, rollback, outcome (adopt/iterate/revert/retire), learning
registers.purpose: Landing-workflow deliverable; defined before traffic starts; one hypothesis at a time where feasible.

registers.name: TOOL_STACK_REGISTER.csv (referenced, external file)
registers.columns: tool, version/configuration, exact reports/exports, market/device/date, cadence, known gaps
registers.purpose: Shared register defining exact tool/report runs; contents not present in this file — must be reviewed before any run list from it is executed.

registers.name: Artifact manifests
registers.columns: artifact, SHA-256 hash
registers.purpose: Immutable baseline evidence integrity; baselines never overwritten (overlay evidence requirements).

registers.name: KPI baseline/target/guardrail sheet
registers.columns: KPI, pre-change baseline, target, guardrail threshold, segment (market/domain/language/location/device/source/page type)
registers.purpose: Gate 1 evidence; guardrail breach blocks Phase 6 proceed.

workflow_skeleton.phase: Phase 0 - Classification, authority and readiness (identical in all 6)
steps: Assign project ID, accountable owner, workflow file, approvers, evidence folder
Classify business model, asset type, new/existing status, project risk
Record production/staging/legacy/campaign domains-subdomains-subfolders
Record target regions, languages, currencies, locations, legal entities, fulfilment, traffic-source routing
Define primary commercial outcome, qualified conversion, secondary conversions, guardrails
Record budget, release date, dependencies, blackout periods, rollback authority
Confirm access to all first-party systems; identify missing data BEFORE recommendations
GATE 0: Project Charter, access register, market/domain map, commercial outcome definition, risk classification

workflow_skeleton.phase: Phase 1 - Research and launch baseline (NEW) / Discovery and protected baseline (EXISTING)
steps: NEW: demand/opportunity baselines from market research, competitor SERPs, paid data, sales/customer research, economics; journeys/intents/objections/proof/conversion paths; select domain+regional architecture BEFORE content/design; proposed business sitemap + URL policy + page inventory + XML sitemap spec; baseline targets with third-party estimates marked as estimates; validate demand before producing entire asset; document assumptions (no history)

EXISTING: freeze dated raw exports (GSC, GA4, GTM, CRM/backend, paid, crawlers, backlinks, server logs, performance); master URL inventory from every discovery source; sitemap/architecture audit; classify every URL protect/refresh/consolidate/redirect/archive-noindex/retire; capture protected-page evidence; record analytics/CRM/forms behaviour; pre-change KPI baselines + guardrail thresholds; defects recorded separately from redesign preferences; interview operators/sales/support

ALL B2B: trust controls (legal entity, case studies, permissioned proof, security/compliance/procurement info, contact ownership) + content controls (industry/vertical, role/persona, solution/use-case, capabilities, comparison/procurement content) + per-type additions (website: CRM/lead-scoring/enrichment/gating/webinar integration; organic: ICP keyword mapping, query-topic-page map, gap benchmark; landing: one audience-problem-offer-next-step, traffic-source map, indexability class, offer economics)
GATE 1: baseline/research pack, risks, protected assets or assumptions, current-state findings, KPI/guardrail sheet

workflow_skeleton.phase: Phase 2 - Strategy/architecture/specification (name varies by asset type)
steps: Approve business requirements, audience, message, offer, differentiation, success measures
Approve IA, proposed sitemap, URL naming rules, navigation, search/filter, internal-linking model
Map ONE primary search intent + ONE primary conversion objective per important page
Page briefs: protected content, proof, CTA, schema, media, localisation, analytics, owner
Define design system, accessibility, content components, all loading/error/empty/success states
Performance budgets by template + third-party script/app governance
Privacy, consent, security, backup, access, incident-response requirements
Implementation backlog with issue IDs, priority, owner, dependencies, acceptance criteria

Deltas — website: full page/template inventory, launch-critical vs phased, governed reusable templates; organic: 12-month roadmap, one owning page per intent cluster + cannibalisation resolution, editorial standards, PR/link plans; landing: message-match chain, one primary conversion + minimum qualification data, control/variant + sample size + guardrails before traffic; EXISTING adds preservation spec + change-impact register + no simultaneous URL/intent/content/layout/offer/tracking changes; ALL B2B: map content/CTA by buying role and stage incl. sales handoff
GATE 2: approved strategy/solution blueprint, page/topic ownership, domain/region decisions, measurement plan, implementation backlog
Build ONLY on controlled staging, production indexing blocked, access restricted
Semantic HTML, crawlable links, status codes, canonicals, directives, schema, responsive media
Navigation, breadcrumbs, contextual internal links, cross-market selectors
Analytics events, consent, CRM/backend integrations, QA logging
Performance budgets, image/font strategy, caching, CDN, third-party controls
Accessible keyboard/focus/form/modal/error behaviour
Release notes; every change mapped to requirement/issue ID

Deltas — website: all priority templates with real content early, custom 404/error/success states; organic: fix technical/indexation before scaling content, publish only after editorial/SEO/factual/link/conversion QA, dashboards; landing: fast focused page, campaign-safe URL/canonical/OG; EXISTING: old-vs-new comparison, preserve production until new passes; ALL B2B: integrate CRM campaign/member status, lead scoring, routing, SLA, opportunity-source preservation
GATE 3: build complete on controlled environment, release notes, owner checks, no unexplained scope gaps
HTML crawl + JavaScript crawl + XML sitemap crawl + all-known-URL list crawl
Compare staging vs approved page inventory (and vs production baseline for existing assets)
Validate robots.txt, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag, canonicals, status codes, hreflang, sitemaps, structured data
Test every primary user task across devices/browsers/languages/currencies/network conditions
Test forms, calls, WhatsApp, booking, CRM, search, account, cart, checkout, payments, email, error recovery
Validate GA4/GTM/pixels, consent, attribution, ecommerce values, backend reconciliation
Field/lab performance, accessibility, security, privacy, visual regression tests
Migration rehearsal, redirect tests, DNS/SSL/CDN plan, backup + rollback rehearsal
Signed Launch Readiness certificate — unresolved P0 issues STOP launch

Deltas — website: sample every template not only homepage, verify all link destinations; organic: per-template indexability validation, reject thin/repetitive content vs competing results; landing: click every ad/email/referral destination, real submissions verified downstream, speed under paid-social mobile networks; EXISTING: regression vs protected baseline, resolve every unexplained loss
GATE 4: test cases, crawl/report exports, fixed/retested P0-P1, signed Launch Readiness certificate
Open launch command centre; record exact release time/version and responsible participants
Deploy via approved sequence; preserve rollback path
Immediately validate availability, SSL, robots/noindex, canonicals, priority URLs, redirects, sitemap, analytics
Complete a REAL primary conversion; verify in frontend, backend/CRM, analytics, notifications
Check markets, languages, currencies, locations, availability, traffic-source destinations
Submit/update GSC sitemaps + platform/feed destinations (submission is not guaranteed indexing)
Record incidents, owner, resolution, retest evidence

Deltas — organic: record publication/discovery dates; landing: previous page/control preserved + traffic allocation confirmed; EXISTING: redirect/change map + control metrics + rollback triggers active
GATE 5: live validation record, completed real conversion, incident log, sitemap/feed/ads checks, acceptance-or-rollback decision
Within 24h: full production crawl vs final staging/production baseline
Inspect priority URLs, redirect sources, sitemap processing, 404/5xx, canonicals, schema, rendering
Monitor transactions/forms, qualified conversions, revenue, paid destinations, feeds, support incidents
Monitor organic clicks/impressions, rankings, indexation, crawl activity, backlink destinations
Compare performance/conversion by template, device, region, language, source, location

Stabilisation review + approval before closing the launch project

STABILISATION EXIT: critical paths stable, P0/P1 closed or accepted, performance understood vs correct baseline

readings.summary: This batch covers the Shopify specialist manual (6 near-identical Phase 0-8 workflows for new/existing store, organic, landing, each with a Version 2 Agency-OS Overlay), the International/Localization manual, the Monitoring/Regression/CI manual, and the Research Library (evidence-class taxonomy + 61-source register). The Shopify manual carries the package's full common workflow skeleton: Gate 0-5 evidence blocks, signed Launch Readiness certificate with P0-stops-launch, 7-item stop-launch list, 9 AI-agent execution rules, 12-field finding format, 10-metric panel (COM/SEO/TEC/CRO IDs), 6-state decision classification, SHA-256 evidence manifests, and a 6-item do-not-do register. Most mechanisms merge cleanly with v1 (front gates, evidence law, MINE FIRST/PROTECTION MAP, gates registry site classes) and directly implement R2/R3/R6/R7; the main conflict points are AI-agent rule 9 (agent self-updates shared standards, vs v1 owner-ruled doctrine changes), Phase 5 production/DNS/theme-publish/real-payment steps that must be pinned to humans under HARD GATES 1/3, and several unverifiable GPT-supplied source URLs that must be checked before admission given the never-invent-facts gate.

structures.name: Shopify workflow set (6 workflows)
structures.detail: Workflow IDs, all Version 1.0 issued 2026-07-19: SHOPIFY-NEW_STORE, SHOPIFY-EXISTING_STORE, SHOPIFY-NEW_ORGANIC, SHOPIFY-EXISTING_ORGANIC, SHOPIFY-NEW_LANDING, SHOPIFY-EXISTING_LANDING. Selection rule: match new/existing x store/organic/landing; for mixed projects ONE workflow is primary and others are declared overlays — 'do not silently merge scopes'. Every workflow inherits 7 shared standards: 00_MASTER_OPERATING_SYSTEM, 01_TOOL_AND_REPORT_REGISTER, 02_REGIONAL_DOMAIN_LOCATION_FRAMEWORK, 03_URL_SITEMAP_MIGRATION_STANDARD, 04_MEASUREMENT_ATTRIBUTION_STANDARD, 05_QA_LAUNCH_MONITORING_LOOP, 06_2026_STANDARDS.

structures.name: Gate evidence chain (Gates 0-5 + stabilisation exit)
structures.detail: Gate 0: approved Project Charter, access register, market/domain map, commercial outcome definition, project risk classification. Gate 1: baseline/research pack, risks, protected assets or assumptions, current-state findings, KPI/guardrail sheet. Gate 2: approved strategy/solution blueprint, page/topic ownership, domain/region decisions, measurement plan, implementation backlog. Gate 3: build complete on controlled environment, release notes, owner checks, no unexplained scope gaps. Gate 4: completed test cases, crawl/report exports, fixed/retested P0-P1 issues, SIGNED Launch Readiness certificate (unresolved P0 stops launch). Gate 5: live validation record, completed real conversion, incident log, sitemap/feed/ads checks, acceptance-or-rollback decision. Stabilisation exit: critical paths stable, P0/P1 regressions closed or accepted, performance understood against the correct baseline.

structures.name: V2 Overlay: Phase control and proof matrix (do-not-proceed conditions)
structures.source: SHOPIFY_OPERATING_MANUAL_2026.md, repeated verbatim after each workflow
structures.detail: Per-phase 'Do not proceed when' stop conditions: P0 no owner/unclear denominator/missing commercial source/unauthorized scope; P1 incomplete URL discovery, baseline overwritten, estimates presented as truth; P2 recommendation lacks metric/cause/economics/acceptance criteria/evidence; P3 design changes without purpose or protected-elements list; P4 production-only edits, untraceable app/plugin/config changes; P5 open P0, unaccepted P1, broken conversion/redirect/tracking/backup; P6 guardrail breach or inability to verify live commercial path; P7 unexplained material revenue/conversion/indexation/ranking loss; P8 vanity reporting, no owner, repeated recommendations with no learning. Phase 7 comparison windows: 24h/72h/7d/28d vs pre-release and seasonal baselines.

structures.name: Stop-launch list ('Do not launch or close the release if', 7 items)
structures.detail: 1) primary conversion/CRM-order/payment path fails; 2) production indexability, canonicals, sitemap or priority redirects wrong; 3) analytics cannot measure primary outcome or duplicates material events; 4) target market receives wrong language/currency/availability/price/shipping/contact route; 5) critical security/privacy/accessibility/legal issue remains; 6) protected high-value content/links/URLs/proof removed without approved evidence; 7) rollback, owners or command-centre coverage unavailable for a material release.

structures.name: AI-agent execution rules (9 rules, x6 occurrences)
structures.detail: 1 select correct workflow first; 2 never infer an existing URL/page has no value without checking all discovery+commercial sources; 3 label every finding as observed fact / calculated result / tool estimate / user-provided assumption / recommendation (5-class evidence labelling); 4 attach evidence and affected URLs to every issue; 5 no issue closure without retest evidence; 6 escalate conflicts between commercial truth and third-party SEO scores, do not optimise for the score; 7 preserve immutable pre-change exports and screenshots; 8 STOP at phase gates requiring accountable approval, never silently bypass; 9 add new learnings to the shared standard and relevant workflow rather than keeping them only in chat.

structures.name: Exact finding format (12 mandatory fields)
structures.detail: 1 issue ID/phase/severity; 2 exact metric formula + affected dimensions; 3 current value, period, source of truth; 4 comparable own baseline + competitor peer values/percentiles + applicable external benchmark; 5 absolute/relative gap + confidence; 6 affected URLs/products/locations/campaigns/cohorts; 7 likely mechanism with corroborating evidence; 8 exact recommendation + owner + dependency; 9 acceptance criteria + automated/manual test; 10 business guardrail + monitoring window + rollback condition; 11 what must not be done; 12 excluded alternatives and why.

structures.name: Required metric panel (10 metrics with IDs)
structures.source: SHOPIFY_OPERATING_MANUAL_2026.md V2 overlay; columns ID|Metric|Source|Target method|Red flag|Improvement path
structures.detail: COM-001 Revenue (OWN seasonal baseline + ECONOMIC plan); COM-002 Contribution margin (ECONOMIC by business model); COM-003 Revenue per session (OWN baseline, peer context only); COM-007 LTV (OWN cohorts, model assumptions documented); SEO-006 Indexable URL count (equals approved inventory within explained variance); TEC-004 LCP P75 (Good <=2.5s / NI 2.5-4s / poor >4s, cited [G12]); TEC-005 INP P75 (Good <=200ms / NI 200-500ms / poor >500ms [G12]); CRO-005 Add-to-cart rate; CRO-006 Checkout completion; CRO-008 Return/refund rate. Target-method benchmark classes used: OWN (own baseline/cohorts), ECONOMIC (business-model plan), peer/context-only, specification-equality. Non-contiguous IDs (COM-004/005/006, SEO-001..005 absent) imply a fuller Metric Dictionary elsewhere in the package.

structures.name: Competitor and market-share requirements
structures.detail: 9 competitor set types built separately: direct, SERP, paid, marketplace, local, publisher, substitute, AI-answer, aspirational. Peer statistics: current + peer median / upper-quartile / leader on identical market/device/language/period. 7 opportunity classifications: defend, mandatory parity, flank, attack, category-creation, partner, deliberate-ignore. Quantify addressable demand, attainable share, qualified conversion, contribution, confidence. Archive competitor pages/ads/offers/reviews/SERPs with date+region+source; never infer spend/performance from an ad library. Cadence: priority competitor panel monthly, complete market map quarterly. Attack patterns (Shopify): catalog/feed/search/merchandising advantages; remove app/theme friction with measured impact; increase profitable CVR/AOV/repeat by market.

structures.name: Evidence and completion requirements + 6-state decision classification
structures.detail: Archive raw PDF plus CSV/JSON/crawl/log and configuration; generate SHA-256 manifest and NEVER overwrite baseline evidence; link each closed issue to implementation reference + staging proof + live proof + monitored result; record decisions as one of: included, deferred, not applicable, rejected, unknown, accepted-risk; P0/P1 closure and launch gates require independent HUMAN review.

structures.name: Mandatory do-not-do register (6 prohibited shortcuts)
structures.detail: No redesign for visual novelty without measurable purpose; no delete/redirect of an existing page without master-URL and preservation checks; no benchmark whose definition/segment is not comparable; no copying competitor content/claims/creative/dark patterns; no closing work before live evidence and monitoring; no unexplained ignored recommendations — use the Decision/Exclusion Register.

structures.name: Existing-asset URL classification chain
structures.detail: Classify every URL: protect | refresh | consolidate | redirect | archive/noindex | retire. Master URL inventory built from EVERY discovery source (never navigation/sitemap alone); freeze dated raw exports (GSC, GA4, GTM, CRM/backend, paid media, crawlers, backlinks, server logs, performance tools); capture screenshots/copy/metadata/schema/internal links/conversion components for protected pages; preservation specification + change-impact register per protected asset; avoid simultaneous changes to URL+intent+content+layout+offer+tracking unless approved.

structures.name: Shopify-specific controls
structures.detail: Trust controls (5): merchant identity/policies; accurate product/variant/inventory data; shipping/duties/taxes/returns/delivery by market; reviews and product proof; payment security/support/order status. Content controls (5): products/collections/pages/blogs; search/filter/merchandising content; market-language localisation; product schema/feed content; post-purchase and retention. Competitive edge controls (5): capture+test theme/app/script governance; products/variants/collections/tags; Markets/languages/currencies; feeds/inventory/checkout/redirects; web performance and search analytics. Hard build rules: duplicate theme — never edit live theme directly for a major release; app register with business value, cost, scripts, data, schema, theme changes, uninstall residue; audit platform URL constraints/auto-canonicals/app-proxy URLs; reconcile orders/revenue/discounts/tax/shipping/refunds between platform, analytics and finance.

structures.name: Roles and sign-off table (9 roles)
structures.detail: Accountable business owner (commercial outcome, scope, priority, budget, acceptance); Project/product owner (requirements, gates, evidence); SEO/content; Design/UX/CRO; Development/DevOps (deployment and rollback); Analytics/data; CRM/sales/ecommerce operations (revenue truth); Market/legal/privacy owner (localisation, claims, consent, market approval); QA (independent test execution, evidence, retest).

structures.name: Localization manual structures
structures.detail: S1 Market matrix: one row per country/region x language x currency x legal entity x fulfilment model x location with 12 recorded fields (addressable customers/priority; products excluded; price/tax/duty/shipping/returns/payments; legal/claims/privacy; support SLA; capacity; domain+canonical policy; language-locale code + hreflang relationship; acquisition sources + exact landing destinations; Business Profiles/listings/reviews; translation owner/glossary/style guide/reviewer; fallback experience). S2 Domain architecture decision record MUST explain rejected architectures. S3 Localization workflow, 9 numbered steps: 1 localization-ready approved source content; 2 terminology/glossary + prohibited claims; 3 translate with context not strings; 4 localize keyword demand (never direct-translate keyword lists); 5 adapt examples/proof/imagery/offers/payment/legal; 6 linguistic+functional+SEO+accessibility+visual QA; 7 validate URLs/canonicals/hreflang/selectors/analytics dimensions; 8 market owner AND legal/clinical approval where applicable; 9 monitor wrong-market landings/switchbacks/local conversion/support. S4 Technical requirements (9): stable crawlable locale URLs; self-canonical unless justified; reciprocal hreflang + optional x-default; equivalent-page alternates only; persistent language/currency selector; no opaque forced IP redirection; local XML sitemaps/GSC properties; localized metadata/schema/feed/org details; redirect+fallback rules for removed market pages. S5 Local location workflow: no doorway pages, no fake locations; genuinely useful local info + operational conversion path. S7 10 commonly missed edge controls (deep links bypassing market selectors; display-vs-charge currency mismatch; untranslated validation/error/email; schema/feed vs visible page; legal/medical claims copied across jurisdictions; phone routing/recording consent; hreflang to redirects/noindex/noncanonical; non-crawlable JS locale selector; sold-out products still advertised; non-lawful reviews per market).

structures.name: Monitoring architecture: 5 layers + 6-row cadence table
structures.detail: Layers: 1 Availability and revenue protection; 2 Search eligibility and migration protection; 3 Experience and conversion; 4 Commercial quality; 5 Competitive position. Cadence table (Cadence|Controls|Audience|Output): Real-time/hourly -> Operations/development -> incident or no-notification rule; Daily during launch -> Launch command centre -> daily launch log; Weekly for 8-12 weeks -> Project team -> Stabilization scorecard; Monthly -> Leadership/channel owners -> Monthly operating review; Quarterly -> Steering group -> Quarterly growth plan; Annual/pre-rebuild -> Executive sponsor -> approved annual roadmap or rebuild charter.

structures.name: Alert design schema + P0/P1 catalogs
structures.detail: Every alert records 9 fields: metric, scope, baseline method, threshold, minimum duration, owner, notification channel, diagnostic runbook, rollback authority; seasonality suppressed only via documented maintenance windows. Default P0 (7): production/critical conversion fails twice from independent checks; payment/form/booking to zero or backend delivery fails; homepage/major template noindex/blocked/canonical elsewhere; widespread 5xx or DNS/SSL failure; material revenue/lead collapse beyond approved guardrail; critical security/data exposure; wrong-market pricing/claims/availability with material impact. P1 (7): priority-page indexation/redirect loss; unexplained GSC decline; CWV priority template becomes poor; Merchant disapproval spike; checkout/form abandonment or error-rate rise; review sentiment/local visibility deterioration in priority location; competitor captures a strategic demand cluster.

structures.name: Regression comparison bases (9) + regression report contents
structures.detail: Compare: last vs previous run; post-release vs pre-release baseline; current vs seasonally comparable period; actual vs target/guardrail; own vs named peers (identical methodology); mobile vs desktop; each market/language/domain/location; each template and traffic source; new vs returning customer/cohorts. Report must list: added/removed/changed URLs; status/canonical/directive/title/H1/schema/internal-link differences; performance changes; conversion changes; unexplained gaps.

structures.name: Continuous improvement loop (10 steps) + experiment governance + executive scorecard
structures.detail: 10 steps: observe -> validate data/segment -> diagnose mechanism (multi-source) -> quantify impact+confidence -> prioritize by opportunity score -> define hypothesis/change/primary metric/guardrails/acceptance -> implement controlled change -> QA tracking+UX before interpreting -> adopt/iterate/revert/reject -> store learning + update decision/exclusion register + refine standard. (Workflow files compress this to a 7-step Phase 8 loop ending 'adopt, iterate, revert or retire'.) Experiment governance: stable assignment, exposure logging, sample-size/power method, pre-defined primary metric, guardrails, stopping rule, data-quality check; no peeking/cherry-picking; quasi-experimental designs labelled with limitations. Executive scorecard: max 10-15 decision metrics on top page (11 listed incl. open P0/P1 + accepted risks, market-share proxy trend, strategic attack initiative progress); detail in appendices.

structures.name: Research library: evidence classes + admission control
structures.detail: Snapshot date 2026-07-19. 5 evidence classes: 1 primary standards/first-party platform docs (highest authority); 2 large-sample independent research (context, not guarantee); 3 academic (preprints labelled); 4 vendor docs/datasets (authoritative for the tool only); 5 Reddit/forums/YouTube/expert opinion (failure-mode discovery only — NEVER used alone to set a target or assert causality). Admission rule: future research admitted only through the Source Register and change-control process.

structures.name: Source register (61 sources)
structures.detail: ID blocks: G01-G22 Google/Google Ads primary (incl. G12 CWV thresholds, G14 AI optimization guide, G15 2026 Gen-AI performance reports); W01-W04 W3C/JSON Schema (WCAG 2.2, PROV provenance, JSON Schema 2020-12 for agent-output validation); O01-O02 OWASP (Top 10 2025; Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026); S01-S05 Shopify; SF01-SF03 Screaming Frog; SE01-SE02 Semrush; DF01-DF02 DataForSEO; SW01 Similarweb; GT01 GTmetrix; PW01 Playwright visual regression; GH01-GH02 GitHub (artifact attestations, protected branches); BM01-BM03 Baymard; UB01 Unbounce; CXL01; YT01-YT04 (YouTube videos); A01-A03 arXiv preprints; R01-R03 Reddit anecdotal. Metric-panel citations ([G12]) resolve against these IDs.

registers.name: SOURCE_REGISTER.csv
registers.columns: source_id, publisher, evidence_class, title, url, used_for
registers.purpose: Canonical research-source register (61 rows); only entry path for new research into the OS, via change control. Duplicated human-readable in REFERENCE_URLS.md with identical fields.

registers.name: Decision/Exclusion Register
registers.columns: decision states: included | deferred | not applicable | rejected | unknown | accepted-risk (per recommendation, with reason)
registers.purpose: Records disposition of every recommendation; ignored recommendations must be explained here (do-not-do register item 6). Direct vehicle for owner requirements R2 and R3.

registers.name: App register (Shopify)
registers.columns: app, business value, cost, scripts, data, schema, theme changes, uninstall residue
registers.purpose: Governs minimal app/script footprint; required in Phase 1 of all six Shopify workflows.

registers.name: Preservation register / preservation specification + change-impact register
registers.columns: protected asset, protected elements (URLs, copy, layouts, CTAs, proof, forms, links, tracking), change impact
registers.purpose: Existing-asset workflows only; feeds Gate 4 regression checks against the protected baseline. v1 counterpart: PROTECTION MAP.

registers.name: Master URL inventory + redirect/change map
registers.columns: URL, discovery sources, classification (protect/refresh/consolidate/redirect/archive-noindex/retire), redirect target
registers.purpose: Required deliverable of EXISTING_* workflows; built from all discovery sources, never navigation/sitemap alone.

registers.name: Issue register / implementation backlog
registers.columns: issue ID, phase, severity, priority, owner, dependencies, acceptance criteria (+12-field finding format per finding)
registers.purpose: Backbone of Phases 2-8; every change maps to a requirement or issue ID; closure requires retest evidence and staging+live proof links.

registers.name: Alert register
registers.columns: metric, scope, baseline method, threshold, minimum duration, owner, notification channel, diagnostic runbook, rollback authority
registers.purpose: Monitoring manual S3; every alert must carry all 9 fields.

registers.name: Market/domain/location matrix
registers.columns: country/region x language x currency x legal entity x fulfilment x location + 12 localization fields (see structures)
registers.purpose: Localization manual S1; must exist before architecture decisions; Gate 0 deliverable in all workflows.

registers.name: Control/variant and experiment (learning) register
registers.columns: control/variant, hypothesis, sample-size approach, primary metric, guardrails, stopping rule, outcome, learning
registers.purpose: Landing-page workflows; defined before traffic starts; one hypothesis at a time where feasible.

registers.name: Traffic-source/message-match matrix
registers.columns: campaign, keyword/ad, creative, email/referrer, region, device, expected intent, destination
registers.purpose: Landing-page workflows Phase 1 deliverable; every ad/email/referral destination clicked and verified in Phase 4.

registers.name: Access register
registers.columns: system, access status, missing data
registers.purpose: Gate 0 evidence; first-party system access confirmed and gaps identified before any recommendation.

registers.name: TOOL_STACK_REGISTER.csv (referenced, not in this batch)
registers.columns: referenced from 'Required tool/report runs' — exact first-party/crawl/competitor/performance/behavioural/commercial reports with tool/version/configuration, market/device/date, known gaps
registers.purpose: Dependency: the Shopify overlay mandates running and archiving exactly what this register specifies; assigned to another reader.

workflow_skeleton.phase: Phase 0 - Classification, authority and readiness (identical across all 6 workflows)
steps: Assign project ID, accountable owner, workflow file, approvers, evidence folder
Classify business model, asset type, new/existing status, project risk
Record production/staging/legacy/campaign domains
Record target regions, languages, currencies, locations, legal entities, fulfilment, traffic-source routing
Define primary commercial outcome, qualified conversion, secondary conversions, guardrails
Record budget, release date, dependencies, blackout periods, rollback authority
Confirm first-party access and identify missing data BEFORE recommendations
GATE 0 evidence block

workflow_skeleton.phase: Phase 1 - NEW variants: 'Research and launch baseline' / EXISTING variants: 'Discovery and protected baseline'
steps: NEW: demand/opportunity baselines, journeys, domain+regional architecture selected before content/design, proposed business sitemap + URL policy + XML sitemap spec, third-party estimates marked as estimates, assumptions documented (no history exists)

EXISTING: freeze dated raw exports (GSC/GA4/GTM/CRM/paid/crawlers/backlinks/logs/perf), master URL inventory from every discovery source, sitemap+architecture audit, classify every URL protect/refresh/consolidate/redirect/archive-noindex/retire, capture protected-page evidence, pre-change KPI baselines + guardrail thresholds, interview operators for hidden URL dependencies
Shopify (all): export catalog/theme/apps/markets/redirects/metafields/feeds; audit platform URL constraints; create app register

Track-specific inserts: STORE=theme/Liquid+Markets+checkout stack; ORGANIC=query-topic-page map, competitor benchmark, gap identification; LANDING=traffic-source/audience map, indexability class (SEO indexable / paid-only noindex / evergreen / temporary / test variant), offer economics
Shopify trust controls (5) + content controls (5)
GATE 1 evidence block

workflow_skeleton.phase: Phase 2 - Strategy/specification (title varies: STORE='Site strategy, architecture and specification'; ORGANIC='Organic strategy, architecture and roadmap'; LANDING='Offer, message, page and experiment specification')
steps: Common core: approve business requirements; approve IA + proposed sitemap + URL naming + navigation + internal-linking model; ONE primary search intent + ONE primary conversion per important page; page briefs; design system + accessibility + all loading/error/empty/success states; performance budgets by template + third-party script governance; privacy/consent/security/backup/incident requirements; backlog with issue IDs/owner/acceptance criteria
ORGANIC adds: 12-month technical/content/authority roadmap; one owning page per intent cluster, cannibalisation resolved before expansion; editorial standards; digital PR/link-earning plans
LANDING adds: message-match chain ad->headline->proof->offer->CTA; one primary conversion + minimum qualification data; control/variant + experiment design + sample size + guardrails BEFORE traffic
EXISTING adds: preservation specification + change-impact register; avoid simultaneous URL+intent+content+layout+offer+tracking changes unless approved
Shopify adds: Markets architecture approval; theme/Liquid/metafield architecture before page-builder proliferation; native-vs-app responsibility decisions; margin guardrails on merchandising journeys
GATE 2 evidence block

workflow_skeleton.phase: Phase 3 - Build (STORE='Design, content, development and integration'; ORGANIC='Technical, content, authority and conversion implementation'; LANDING='Landing-page build and integration')
steps: Build ONLY on controlled staging, production indexing blocked, access restricted
Semantic HTML, crawlable links, status codes, canonicals, schema; analytics events + consent + CRM integrations; performance budgets; accessibility; custom 404/error/success states
Release notes; every change mapped to requirement or issue ID
ORGANIC: fix technical/indexation constraints before scaling content; publish only after editorial+SEO+factual/claims+link+conversion QA
LANDING: fast focused page, limited navigational leakage; campaign-safe URL/canonical/OG decisions
EXISTING: maintain old-vs-new comparison, preserve existing production asset until new version passes
Shopify: duplicate theme (never edit live theme for major release); test customer events/pixels/GA4/consent without duplication; import/test redirects
GATE 3 evidence block

workflow_skeleton.phase: Phase 4 - Pre-launch or pre-release QA (common title)
steps: 4 crawl types: HTML, JavaScript, XML-sitemap, all-known-URL list
Validate robots/meta-robots/X-Robots-Tag/canonicals/status codes/hreflang/sitemaps/structured data
Test every primary user task across devices/browsers/languages/currencies/network conditions; forms/calls/WhatsApp/booking/CRM/cart/checkout/payments
GA4/GTM/pixels/consent/attribution/backend reconciliation; performance/accessibility/security/privacy/visual regression
Migration rehearsal + redirect tests + DNS/SSL/CDN plan + backup + rollback rehearsal where applicable

Sample every template, not only homepage (STORE); every published template indexability + content differentiation vs actual competing results (ORGANIC); click every ad/email/referral destination + real submissions/purchases + paid-social mobile network speed (LANDING); regression checks vs protected baseline, resolve every unexplained loss (EXISTING)
Shopify: full checkout matrix incl. payment failure/refund/gift cards; sitemap child files; Markets/hreflang; theme/app perf regressions by template; notification emails/fulfilment
SIGNED Launch Readiness certificate; unresolved P0 STOPS launch — GATE 4 evidence block

workflow_skeleton.phase: Phase 5 - Launch or controlled release (common title)
steps: Open launch command centre; record exact release time/version/participants
Deploy via approved sequence; preserve rollback path
Immediate validation: availability, SSL, robots/noindex, canonicals, priority URLs, redirects, sitemap, analytics
Complete a REAL primary conversion verified in frontend + backend/CRM + analytics + notifications
Check target markets/languages/currencies/inventory/traffic-source destinations
Submit/update GSC sitemaps + feeds; submission is not guaranteed indexing
EXISTING adds: release with redirect/change map + control metrics + rollback triggers active; LANDING adds: previous page/control preserved, traffic allocation confirmed
Shopify: publish approved theme/config; verify Markets routing, feeds, checkout immediately
GATE 5 evidence block (acceptance or rollback decision)
Within 24 hours full production crawl vs final staging/production baseline
Inspect priority URLs, redirects, sitemap processing, 404/5xx, canonicals, schema, rendering
Monitor transactions, conversions, revenue, feeds, support incidents; organic clicks/rankings/indexation/crawl
Compare by template/device/region/language/source/location; fix P0/P1 immediately with root cause + preventive control

NEW variants: establish first stable 4-8 week operating baseline before normalising targets; EXISTING variants: compare vs recent AND seasonal baselines, investigate losses by page/segment; ORGANIC adds cohort-of-changes review; LANDING adds lead/order-quality review before declaring a conversion winner
Shopify: reconcile orders/revenue/discounts/tax/shipping/refunds across platform/analytics/finance
Stabilisation review + approval before closing launch project — stabilisation exit condition

Collect evidence from users, sales/support, commercial systems, search, crawls, competitors
Diagnose constraint + affected segment; never jump from a metric to a cosmetic solution
Prioritise by business impact, reach, confidence, risk, effort
